name: transcript-refiner
description: Fix what speech-to-text misheard in a transcript (.vtt) with your own model — every segment and timing kept, every change listed

tools.title: Refine Transcript (AI)
tools.description: Correct speech-to-text mistakes in a WebVTT transcript using the user's own configured model: misheard words, spacing, misspelled names (an optional glossary .md lists the right spellings). Every segment and every timing is kept; a segment that is meaningless becomes [unclear]; a correction that changes too much is not applied but listed as rejected, with the original, for a person to decide. Requires path (.vtt), outputPath (the refined .vtt) and changesPath (a .json listing applied and rejected changes). Refuses to overwrite existing files.
